page_title: WER 1-2 WOL | Werder Bremen v Wolfsburg 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 2 Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes into the top right corner.
89' Substitution. Andreas Skov Olsen will be replaced by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg).
89' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) replacing Jonas Wind.
86' Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

85' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
84' The corner kick from Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
83' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
82' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
82' The resulting corner from Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.
79' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
75' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
75' The attendance is 41152.
73' The game is interrupted now, Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) for Patrick Wimmer.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) will replace Leonardo Bittencourt.
72' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) replaces Felix Agu.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andre Silva as he is replaced by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen).
71' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but Marius Muller makes a magnificent save!
70' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Felix Brych ignores the protests.
69' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Felix Brych blows for a foul.
66' The game is interrupted as Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) is flagged offside.
65' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Bence Dardai is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
65' Substitution. Mohamed Amoura did his best and is replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
63' The linesman raises his flag. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
62' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
62' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
61' Werder Bremen couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Marius Muller (Wolfsburg) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
61' The referee blows his whistle as Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Felix Brych blows for a foul after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
56' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
52' 2:1 – the corner kicks stats.

48' 0 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Michael Zetterer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 0:2.
48' Andreas Skov Olsen (Wolfsburg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
47' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Half-time substitution. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is replaced by Anthony Jung.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' It looks like Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) saw red with that tackle. Felix Brych won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
42' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:6.
39' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Werder Bremen fail to score from a corner as Marius Muller (Wolfsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
35' The free kick into the penalty area from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
35' Andre Silva (Werder Bremen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
30' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
25' Wolfsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
22' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

22' Marius Muller pulls off a brilliant save! Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. The referee signals a corner kick to Werder Bremen.
20' The goalkeeper dives to deny Andre Silva (Werder Bremen), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
19' A snap shot by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Marius Muller produces a good save to thwart him.

18' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Brych with no other option than to blow for a foul.
14' Rough tackle by Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' One of the Werder Bremen players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.

12' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' Dangerous play by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen). Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
6' 0 - 1 Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) rises above the defence to meet a cross after the corner kick. He's having some lucky day, because the ball deflects off his body into the net.
6' The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
4' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
